items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Teo Macero and Miles invited me to the session at Columbia where they’d be editing that day.

ctx.x: Yeah. Teo Macero and Miles invited me to the session at Columbia where they’d be editing that day. I was told they’d be working on The Duke. When I came into the control room, I was introduced to Gil. He said, “Brubeck? Did you have a brother?” I said, “Yeah.” He said, “He played drums with me. He was a great drummer.” That’s how I met Gil. Then I [ ] after that. After he died, I was invited to his house by his wife, after I was here in Connecticut.
The two of you grew up not too far from each other, and your brother played with him. Now I understand.
